title: Papoose Lake map altered eight days after Lazar went public

tellings.quote: But the stamp of the exact day is May 23rd, 1989. Exactly 8 days after Bob went public.

plain: Luigi Vendetelli, a researcher, told podcast host Jesse Michels that government geological maps of Papoose Lake and Groom Lake, dry lake beds in the Nevada desert on secret military land, were changed in 1989. He says the change is stamped May 23rd, 1989, exactly eight days after Bob Lazar, a man who went public with claims about secret work at the site, first spoke out. If true, it would suggest the government moved quickly to hide the place Lazar described.
